description: Look up tap-water hardness for a South Orange County city (plus Irvine). Returns the hardness in grains per gallon (gpg), what that level means for a home, and whole-house treatment guidance following Joey's rule: HALO 5 is the default pick in hard-water cities where a drain is reachable (it requires a drain line for its weekly backwash plus an outlet); the H2 Zero line is the pick where no drain is reachable; H2 Zero Scale Media is an option in moderate San Clemente. Cities not in the dataset get an honest general area range, never an invented number.

city.description: City name, e.g. 'Laguna Niguel', 'Mission Viejo', 'San Clemente'.

name: check_water_hardness
